events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary Monty Python star and Fawlty Towers creator, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: He's not the Messiah, he's a very naughty boy! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese. From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles', commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic LP
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, the 'White Album'. Which track is your absolute favourite from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Unmatched Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost one of the most electrifying performers of all time, Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in 1965.

angles.name: Pivotal Album
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in pop history: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61 today. The album where they truly started stretching the boundaries of pop.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, and the music and message of John Lennon continue to resonate. A true icon, forever missed.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary 'Starman' David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Iconic Starman
angles.copy: Forever pushing boundaries and inspiring generations. Remembering the incredible David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: King of Rock
angles.copy: Long live the King! Remembering Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. His legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock and continue to inspire guitarists everywhere.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Still Rocking
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: One Step Beyond
angles.copy: One step beyond! Happy 66th birthday to the inimitable Suggs, the voice of Madness and a true British institution.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Soulful Voice
angles.copy: From the Q-Tips to solo stardom, Paul Young is 71 today! Still got that soulful voice.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music superstar, Dolly Parton, who passed away in August 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Dolly
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music and spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Still very much in demand! Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's Gary Barlow.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Get outta my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a happy 77th birthday! A voice that defined the 80s.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place in 1989, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors to its first legendary inductees. Who do you think was the most deserving of that initial honour?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Still going strong with Take That! Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London in 1969.

angles.name: Legendary Rooftop
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Against All Odds
angles.copy: Against all odds, Phil Collins turns 76 today! A true legend of rock and pop.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Charming Brit
angles.copy: From rom-coms to villainous roles, Hugh Grant is 67 today! Still charming us on screen.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The multi-talented singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for 46 years! Happy birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor Sir David Jason, known for Only Fools and Horses, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason. A true national treasure.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Rock Pioneers
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, rock and roll lost three of its brightest stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The 'Never Gonna Give You Up' singer Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Up
angles.copy: He's never gonna give up on turning another year older! Happy 61st birthday to the legendary Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Remembering the legendary Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His message still resonates.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The influential singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Beautiful Legacy
angles.copy: From songwriting legend to solo superstar, Carole King is 85 today! Her music truly has a 'Beautiful' legacy.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the passing of the incomparable Whitney Houston, who would have been 64.

angles.name: Incredible Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost that incredible voice. Remembering the one and only Whitney Houston.
